audit.limitation: No model weights, raw TraCI traces or scheduler log in bundle. Traffic statistics are recomputed from per-run waits/counts; critic predictions and phase conflicts cannot be independently replayed here.

pilot_summary.interpretation: Exploratory pilot; three initialisations and one seeded action stream per demand. No confirmatory claim.

protocol.actor_evaluation: categorical; fixed per-demand/per-junction streams shared across arms
protocol.budget: Equal 64x600 simulation seconds/model; A/B 64 update batches; C 16. Four PPO passes per batch.
protocol.normalization: cumulative training GAE-target moments; PopArt-style raw-output preservation; no evaluation updates
protocol.selection: Final episode checkpoint only; validation does not select a model
